Group rides in Pittsburgh, PA

3 recurring group rides around Pittsburgh, PA: 3 road, 1 social. 2 roll on weeknights, 1 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Major Taylor Cycling PGH Wednesday Ride in Pittsburgh — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Pgh Babes on Bikes Frigid Witch Training Rides runs a/B/C pace groups; C group stays together, A and B are drop rides.
